versions.changelog: display name now leads with the capability
Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

Initial release of sec-edgar-api skill.

- Resolve ticker or company name to SEC CIK and exchange with `/lookup`.
- Retrieve filer profiles, SIC, EIN, LEI, and key company data via `/company`.
- Page through and filter company filings with `/filings`.
- List every reported XBRL financial concept via `/facts`.
- Retrieve the full reported value history of an XBRL concept using `/concept`.
- Run full-text search of SEC EDGAR filings from 2001 to present with `/search`, supporting filters and facets.
- All endpoints return structured JSON; 1 credit per request with API key.
